title: PROTOCOL FOR: LRP37 method
author: Gaku Takahashi

steps_raw.instruction: Equilibrate the temperature of 0.6% dextran solution at 37 °C by the incubation of the solution for about 5 minutes in advance.
Blood is collected with a heparinized syringe.
Allow the blood to equilibrate at 37 ° C for a few minutes.
Add 400 μl of the blood to 800 μl of dextran.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for about 10 to 30 minutes until a supernatant is formed.
Use the supernatant as leukocyte-rich plasma (LRP).
Add 100 μl of the LRP to 900 μl of the pretreatment solution (0.02% tween, FUJI FILM Wako Pure Chemical Incorporation, Osaka, Japan).
The 10-times diluted LRP was mixed five times with a vortex mixer at 3000 rpm for 10 s to ensure the destruction of the white blood cells.
Heat the mixture at 70 °C for 10 minutes to inactivate the interfering factors in blood for the limulus test.
Cool the mixture at 0 °C for 5-10 minutes.
Add 200 μL of the mixture to a freeze-dried endotoxin-specific limulus test; Endotoxin Single test Wako (FUJI FILM Wako) to dissolve the reagent.
Set the test tube containing the mixture and the reagent in the TOXINOMETER (FUJI FILUM Wako) and react at 37 °C for up to 200 minutes.
The amount of transmitted light at the start is defined as100%, and the time during which turbidity is reduced to 92% by endotoxin is defined as the gelation time (min).

A calibration curve is created based on the gelation times of at least three different doses of standard endotoxin (E. coli O111:B4), and the endotoxin content of the sample will be calculated by the gelation time of the sample to be measured.
Since the sample is diluted 10 times with the pretreatment solution at protocol 7), the calculated endotoxin amount will be 10-times.

As the plasma is also diluted by the dextran solution, final endotoxin content in LRP should be calculated by the formulae as follows; (A + dextran volume)/A, wherein A = blood volume - blood volume × haematocrit value/100
(When LRP0 method will be performed, the operating temperature in procedures 1) to 5) should be 0°C by dipping a test tube into crush ice bath.)
